title: Tesla's Megamanifold heat pump recycles motor heat to warm the cabin
title_candidates: How Tesla's heat pump heats your cabin using heat from the motor
The Tesla Semi part that turns wasted motor heat into free cabin warmth
What Tesla built so the Semi never loses the same heat twice
How Tesla's Megamanifold runs heating and cooling from one single part
The reason Tesla's Semi can heat the cabin without burning extra power
caption:
Tesla's Megamanifold is some of the cleverest engineering in any electric vehicle, and most owners don't even know it exists.

It runs the cabin's heat and the motor's cooling in one connected loop. On the Tesla Semi, that means the truck pulls waste heat from the powertrain and uses it to warm the cabin, instead of spending extra battery power generating heat from scratch.

The result is a more efficient truck over long distances, using energy that would otherwise just disappear into the air.
